en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The moment it was over, I felt my legs
give out under me.

<CLT=cltMIND>What I just saw...
didn't feel real.

<CLT=cltMIND>As if all reality had vanished, and the
only thing left was a fictional world.

<CLT=cltMIND>Real or not...
Kaede was gone.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede Akamatsu...
no longer existed in our world.

Huh? What the...?
Wh-Why is Monokid...?

M-Monodam?
What...have you done...?
...BLRBLRBLRBLRBLRB!
Ah, gross! She puked again!

But this tension ain't so bad, y'know?
Finally feels like a proper killing game.

If anything, we could stand to use a little
more tension in our lives. Right, dad?

Nooo! My sweet, darling Monokid...
Claimed as collateral damage!

This is a nightmare... This is unacceptable...
My precious cub is...

...On second thought, I guess it's okay.
After all, I still got four more cubs!
Phew! I'm glad you kids came in bulk.
...Huh? It's okay?

I-I'm shocked... Our existence...means that
little, huh?

What's done is done, what's dead is dead.
No point crying over crushed cubs...

...Unless you wanna end up like
these sad sacks.

What...!
What in the world...is this...!?

A-Are you...fuckin'...kiddin' me!?
Talk about overkill...!

Atua... Please grant Kaede's soul
eternal repose.

I...I can't believe this happened to Kaede...
I liked her...s-so...m-m-muuuuuch...!

WAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!
KAAAAEEEEEEEDDDEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!

Puhuhu! All this adrenaline creates such
an exquisite <CLT=cltSTRONG>feeling of despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

It's moments like this that make
all the killings worth it!

W-Why...are you doing such
a terrible thing...?

You're the worst of the worst! Does human
life have no value to you at all!?

Hey, I know human life is precious.
I'm not a monster, y'know.

Cuz if human life wasn't precious, ending
it wouldn't be nearly as much fun!

There's no greater joy than witnessing
such a display of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair entertainment<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Kehehe... You've surpassed 
psychotic by a wide margin.

...I don't think I've ever 
felt quite this...irritated.

I... I won't forgive you for this!
Got that!? I won't ever forgive you!
Spoken like a marked man!
What is your objective, Monokuma?

...Do you hate us? If so, have we done
something to make you hate us?
...Hate you?
Puhuhu... Who can say?
That's your job to figure out.

If you really wanna know what's going on,
you're gonna have to work for it.

...Though the corpse formerly known
as Rantaro may have had a hunch.
...Huh?

What do you mean?
What was Rantaro's hunch?
Puhuhu... What, indeed?

He did say he would end this game, and he
also knew about the hidden door...

Could that be at all related to this <CLT=cltSTRONG>hunch<CLT=cltNORMAL>
you claim he had?
Puhuhu... I wonder...

Hey! What the hell's this <CLT=cltSTRONG>hunch<CLT=cltNORMAL> you're
goin' on about!? Spill it!
Puhuhu... I wonder...

If you have no intention of telling us...then
keep your mouth shut.

You're focusing on Kaede instead of her
deadweight victim.

Well, it's not his fault he was useless. He
died before his <CLT=cltSTRONG>talent<CLT=cltNORMAL> could be revealed.

If he had lived long enough to reveal it,
maybe he would've been more useful...

Oh well! He's dead and that's that!
That's the indifference of <CLT=cltSTRONG>death<CLT=cltNORMAL> for ya!
He...wasn't really the mastermind, was he?

Huh? Are you *still* pestering me
with these annoying questions!?

Aren't you guys focusing a little too much
on whether or not there's a mastermind?

If you keep this up, you're all gonna
end up like Kaede.
Wh-What!?

Maybe spend less time worrying about nonsense
and more time watching your back, okay?

You never know who's gonna become
the next killer.

Ah, I can't wait! I wonder what kind
of killing game we'll get to see next!

Dammit! You may have gotten us this time,
but we'll get you next time! You'll see!
Why are you all psyched up...?

It's nice to see that at least one of you
has some chutzpah around here.
I have a feeling you're gonna live for a while.
Thanks! I'll do my best!

Shut the hell up! We're...not gonna have
another killing game!

I, Kaito Momota, am not gonna 
let you have your way anymore!

Got it!? I'm gonna punch that grin
right off your face. For sure!
Oh, really...? That seems unlikely.

I'm pretty sure you won't live long
enough to do that.
Krgh...!
Anyway, you guys have a lot to think about...

Work hard and do your best to graduate!
Cuz the fun's only just begun!
Hey, Monodam! Explain yourself!

I get that Monokid was obnoxious and
rude, but that was way over the line...
...I-DID-IT-FOR-US.
Hey! Wait, Monodam!
Wh-Where are you going!?

He probably killed him as payback for all the
bullying. What an interestin' turn of events...

<CLT=cltMIND>And with that, Monokuma and the cubs left,
and only we remained in the courtroom...
I...I don't think I can take all this...

I can't stand this anymore... 
I-I feel like...I'm going to go crazy...
Tsumugi, you musn't give up hope.

Is there even hope to be had here?
The room feels utterly drained of it.
Gh... Ergh... K-Kaede!

Wh-What kinda d-degenerate male...cries
in p-public...? It's so r-rude...
But, Tenko, you're crying too.

Now's not the time to point 
that out, Keebo. Just let it be.

In times like this, we should pray for
Kaede's soul so she can rest in peace.

H-How's anyone supposed to rest in peace
after getting killed like *that*!?
What are we gonna do from now on...?

Y-Yeah, I'd like to know, too...
I'm so over this already...

Aaargh! Shut up! SHUT! UP!
You all just need to SHUT UP!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's voice boomed in
the air, and the room went silent.

Every single one of you...and your meek 
little complaints...
You're pissing me the hell off!!!
But the one who's pissing me off the most...
...is you, Shuichi!!
...What?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*pow!*
Clench your teeth!

Kaito! You are supposed to say that
*before* you hit him!

Didn't you hear what Kaede said!?
She said...she believed in you!
That she passed her wish on to you!

But what the hell's wrong with you!?
You didn't say a damn thing to Monokuma!
You call yourself a man!?!?

...What's the matter? 
Say something already.

I just hit you! Aren't you pissed off!?
What's your problem!?
...Enough, Kaito.

Sucker punching is pretty low...even for a
lowlife degenerate male like you.

You better knock it off or I'm gonna explode
my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> all over your face!
...Tch. Fine.
Shuichi...are you okay?
...I'm fine.

Please stop. This sort of altercation is
just a waste of time.

Gonta not sure it waste of time.
But Gonta agree, fighting not good...

Can we leave now? Staying here will only
make us more depressed.

Kehehe... Well put. 
I agree wholeheartedly.

Sorry, you all should
go ahead without me...

...Why? Is there a reason you wish to
stay in a place like this?

I want to be alone for a while.
Just for a little bit.

But we can't just leave you here 
by yours-

Tsumugi, perhaps it would be best if we
allowed him some privacy for now...
Oh...okay. I suppose...
Shuichi...don't beat yourself up, 'kay?

Yep! Just hit the reset button on your feelings
and you'll feel happy and cheerful in no time!

Being a tad insensitive is important for
survival. It helps one avoid suicidal thoughts.

Gonta will go back, too... Let Gonta know
if you need his help, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>One by one, everyone
climbed aboard the elevator.
<CLT=cltMIND>Except...

Shuichi...I dunno how well 
you knew Kaede...

But why don't you try 
going to her <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
What do you mean?

Monokuma set the room up, so there's probably
not a lot there to remember her by...

But...there should at least be 
a bunch of little things she liked.
Things...Kaede liked...?

Understand? There's only one way
to get through this awful feeling.

No one's gonna be able to console you 
if you're just sitting here alone.

If anyone's gonna help you,
it'll be her...in your memories.

<CLT=cltMIND>With those words,
he stepped onto the elevator.

<CLT=cltMIND>Before I realized it,
I got to my feet.

<CLT=cltMIND>I just started walking,
and I was headed toward...
<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltMIND>'s Research Lab.
